Prefix moves and single butterfly rounds are $O(dK)$ linear scans, each $O(V)$, in [Tape layout for synthetic transforms](transform-layout.md).
The layout needs $O(p/K)$ chunk exchanges, as $d\ell=O(p)$, each costing $O(VK^\tau)$ by [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-interchange.md). The total is $O(p/K)K^\tau=O(pK^{\tau-1})$.
In [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md), axis $i$ has at most $T/t_i$ lines of cost $O(t_ip^{3/2+\delta}\alpha)$ each, totalling $O(dTp^{3/2+\delta}\alpha)$.
The $T/r$ ring-product records each need four products on $O(rp)$ bits after [Signed packing](signed-packing.md)
A visit is a node of the butterfly-layer or address-layout recursions, or one round or group invocation inside them.
Fix an exponent $A$ with at most $p^A$ visits in total, and an exponent $C$ with descriptor setup of at most $p^C$ steps per visit.
Stable bit sorting makes $O(p)$ scans of it, costing $O(V_{\rm call}dp2^{-K})$.
Each of the seven powers is at most $1-2\kappa$, and any fixed power of $\log p$ is at most $p^\kappa$ eventually
Schoolbook multiplication below a fixed cutoff is absorbed

relations.quote: Cost accounting totals the running time of every step of [The multiplication algorithm](multiplication-algorithm.md) and shows that it is $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$, where $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is the saved exponent.
The layout needs $O(p/K)$ chunk exchanges, as $d\ell=O(p)$, each costing $O(VK^\tau)$ by [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-interchange.md).
Each of at most $\ell$ rounds costs $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ by [Simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-layer.md).
Exceptional addresses, where the packed shifts of [Packed selected-bit addition](packed-bit-addition.md) fail, are a fraction $O(d2^{-K})$ of addresses.

symbols.name: volume
symbols.meaning: The number of stored bits of the T coefficients of p bits, V=Tp.
symbols.quote: Let $V=Tp=\Theta(n)$ be the volume, the number of stored bits of $T$ coefficients of $p$ bits.

symbols.name: margin
symbols.meaning: The margin below one of the i-th dominant power of p, so the power is p^{1-g_i}.
symbols.quote: Dividing by $V$, seven operations dominate, each a power $p^{1-g_i}$ with margin $g_i>0$ below one.

symbols.name: visit exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent such that the recursions make at most p^A visits in total.
symbols.quote: Fix an exponent $A$ with at most $p^A$ visits in total, and an exponent $C$ with descriptor setup of at most $p^C$ steps per visit.

symbols.name: setup exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent such that descriptor setup per visit is at most p^C steps.
symbols.quote: Fix an exponent $A$ with at most $p^A$ visits in total, and an exponent $C$ with descriptor setup of at most $p^C$ steps per visit.

symbols.name: call volume
symbols.meaning: The volume of one packed change of basis.
symbols.quote: Let $V_{\rm call}$ be the volume of one packed change of basis.
